newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-PIRES TO STAY AT METZ AT LEAST UNTIL 1998.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PIRES TO STAY AT METZ AT LEAST UNTIL 1998.

text.p: France winger Robert Pires, who has been courted by Newcastle and Paris St Germain, has agreed to stay at Metz until after the 1998 World Cup finals.

Pires, currently out for a month with a knee ligament injury, is under contract with Metz for a further three years and told club president Carlo Molinari at the weekend he would stay at least until the end of next season.
The 23-year-old forward hopes to be back in France's squad for their World Cup warm-up tournament in June and keep his place for the 1998 finals.
He helped Metz, eighth in the French first division, reach the third round of the UEFA Cup in which they were eliminated by English premier league Newcastle in December.
